_comment: QofAI's standing commercial language, for the studio's one-click default on a
proposal deck's Commercial Terms slide. Content, kept out of the code that
writes it so the wording is edited here and reviewed as text.
WHAT BELONGS HERE: the payment MECHANISM and the risk-reversal clause, which
are the same on every engagement because they describe how QofAI is paid at
all rather than what any one deal pays (Antonio, 2026-08-20: mechanism only).
WHAT DOES NOT: any figure, share, cap, or term. Percentages, a comp schedule,
an investment total and a contract length are per-deal, they are sensitive, and
the deck asks a reviewer for them by name. A default that carried last deal's
numbers into this deal's deck is the exact failure the [MISSING: ...] markers
exist to prevent, and it would arrive looking like a considered figure.
NO CLIENT DETAIL EITHER. This text goes onto a deck for any client, so it says
'the client' and names no company, industry, or asset. The FBK packet's own
wording, which this is derived from, said 'project & fleet EBITDA margin'; the
fleet is FBK's and does not belong in a default.
downside_protection: If margins don't improve above your locked baseline, QofAI earns nothing.

payment_mechanics.rest: Actual EBITDA margin is compared to the client's locked pre-launch baseline; improvement is expressed in margin points.
The margin-point gain is applied to financial performance at the contribution basis locked at signing for the term.
QofAI receives its contracted share of that figure, paid monthly under the agreed comp schedule.
